description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under Inland Revenue Act. (e) III of 3rd Schedule that the official emoluments of any individual who is employed by the Asian Development Bank
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifically regarding tax exemptions for employees of the Asian Development Bank. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
